upstream.title: fix(research): BUG-1 fix wrong model param for token limit detection
upstream.body:
## Summary
In `compress_research`, the token limit detection logic incorrectly uses `configurable.research_model` instead of `configurable.compression_model`.

## Problem
When the compression model is different from the research model (e.g., `research_model="openai:gpt-4o"` and `compression_model="deepseek:deepseek-chat"`), the exception handler fails to recognize token limit errors because `is_token_limit_exceeded` checks the wrong model's provider-specific error patterns. This causes the retry loop to exit early without truncating the messages, resulting in a `"Maximum retries exceeded"` error even when simply truncating would resolve the issue.

## Fix
- Line 569: Replace `configurable.research_model` with `configurable.compression_model` in the `is_token_limit_exceeded` call.

## Impact
- Resolves silent failures when using mixed-model configurations.
- No effect on default setups where both models are identical.
